es: Reescribir una reseña neutra con inversión en los puntos fuertes (never, hardly, not only, so… that) y justificar por qué no se enfatiza todo.

teaching.en: Not only did the fans fill the stadium, but they also sang every song.
teaching.es: Los aficionados no solo llenaron el estadio, sino que además cantaron todas las canciones.
teaching.explanationEs: Not only did + sujeto + verbo base; después, but … also.
segments: Not only did the fans fill the
stadium, but they also sang every song.
teaching.audioText: Not only did the fans fill the stadium, but they also sang every song.

teaching.en: Hardly had the concert started when the crowd began to dance.
teaching.es: Apenas había empezado el concierto cuando la multitud empezó a bailar.
teaching.explanationEs: Hardly had + sujeto + participio, y when para la segunda acción.
segments: Hardly had the concert started when
teaching.audioText: Hardly had the concert started when the crowd began to dance.

teaching.en: Rarely does a single goal decide such an exciting match.
teaching.es: Rara vez un solo gol decide un partido tan emocionante.
teaching.explanationEs: Rarely abre la frase y does precede al sujeto a single goal.
teaching.audioText: Rarely does a single goal decide such an exciting match.

teaching.en: The best moment of the match was the last goal.
teaching.es: El mejor momento del partido fue el último gol.
teaching.explanationEs: Reserva el énfasis para un momento fuerte como este: Never had I seen such a goal.
teaching.audioText: The best moment of the match was the last goal.

teaching.en: Carlos's speech had too much emphasis, so it sounded false.
teaching.es: El discurso de Carlos tenía demasiado énfasis, así que sonaba poco natural.
teaching.explanationEs: False aquí significa forzado, poco natural: si enfatizas todo, nada destaca.
teaching.audioText: Carlos's speech had too much emphasis, so it sounded false.

prompt.es: Completa: «Nunca había visto a los aficionados tan felices.»

feedback.es: La versión enfática de I had never seen es never had I seen.

hint.es: El auxiliar de la frase neutra pasa delante de I.

origin.text: Never ___ I seen the fans so happy.

prompt.es: ¿Qué reescritura conserva el sentido de «The team played well and scored three goals»?

choices.text: Not only the team played well, but it also scored three goals.
Not only did the team played well, but it also scored three goals.
Not only did the team play well, but it also scored three goals.

feedback.es: Not only did + sujeto + verbo base conserva los dos datos; did played duplicaría el pasado.

hint.es: Después de did, el verbo principal vuelve a la forma base.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Tan fuerte cantaron los aficionados que perdieron la voz.»

answer.text: So loudly did the fans sing that they lost their voices

feedback.es: So loudly abre la frase, did precede a the fans y sing queda en forma base.

hint.es: Empieza con so + adverbio y usa did antes del sujeto.

prompt.es: Da énfasis a la frase del texto con never al inicio.

answer.text: Never will I forget this goal.
accepted: Never will I forget this goal.
Never shall I forget this goal.

feedback.es: Never pasa al inicio y el modal will va antes del sujeto I.

origin.text: I will never forget this goal.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué hicieron los aficionados al acabar el partido.

choices.text: They went onto the field just after the game ended.
They left the stadium in silence.
They waited for the players outside.

feedback.es: Hardly had the match finished when… indica que entraron al campo apenas terminó el partido.

origin.audio: Hardly had the match finished when the fans ran onto the field.

prompt.es: Completa tres frases enfáticas de una reseña de concierto.

feedback.es: Not only + did con un verbo normal, no sooner se une con than y so + adjetivo necesita el verbo be antes del sujeto.

sentences: Not only ___ the singer arrive late, but she also forgot the words.
No sooner had the show begun ___ the sound broke down.
So bad ___ the sound that many fans left.

prompt.es: ¿Qué versión enfática respeta el mensaje de la frase del texto?

choices.text: So nervous Carlos was that he forgot his speech.
So nervous was Carlos that he forgot his speech.
Such nervous was Carlos that he forgot his speech.

feedback.es: So + adjetivo abre la frase y was se coloca antes de Carlos; such no se combina con un adjetivo solo.

origin.text: Carlos was so nervous that he forgot his speech.

prompt.es: Escucha y decide qué no sabían los aficionados.

choices.text: That the show would be short.
That the singer was not well.

feedback.es: Little did the fans know… señala algo que ignoraban: la cantante estaba enferma.

origin.audio: Little did the fans know that the singer was ill, but she sang for two hours anyway.

prompt.es: ¿Cómo conviene usar el énfasis en una reseña?

choices.text: Use it only for the strongest moments.
Use it in every sentence of the review.
Never use it in a review.

feedback.es: El énfasis destaca unos pocos puntos fuertes; si se usa siempre deja de destacar y suena forzado.

prompt.es: Reescribe con 3 inversiones y un so… that; añade una frase que explique tu elección.

answer.text: We arrived at the stadium at six. Never had I seen such a big crowd there. Hardly had the match started when the rain began, but nobody left. Not only did the team play well, but it also scored three goals. So happy were the fans that they sang for an hour. We went home on the bus. I used the strong forms only for the best moments, because too much emphasis would sound false.
accepted: We arrived at the stadium at six. Never had I seen such a big crowd there. Hardly had the match started when the rain began, but nobody left. Not only did the team play well, but it also scored three goals. So happy were the fans that they sang for an hour. We went home on the bus. I used the strong forms only for the best moments, because too much emphasis would sound false.

We arrived at the stadium at six. Never had I seen such a big crowd there. No sooner had the match started than the rain began, but nobody left. Not only did the team play well, but it scored three goals too. So happy were the fans that they sang for an hour. We went home on the bus. I used strong forms only for the best moments, because too much emphasis sounds false.

feedback.es: La reseña enfática invierte solo los puntos fuertes, deja neutras las frases de datos y explica que demasiado énfasis suena falso.

origin.text: We arrived at the stadium at six. I had never seen such a big crowd there. The match started and the rain began, but nobody left. The team played well and scored three goals. The fans were so happy that they sang for an hour. We went home on the bus.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Apenas habían salido los jugadores cuando empezó a llover.»

answer.text: Hardly had the players left when it began to rain

feedback.es: Hardly had precede a the players, el participio left sigue y la segunda acción va tras when.

prompt.es: Completa: «Rara vez veo a los aficionados tan tranquilos.»

feedback.es: En presente simple, rarely obliga a añadir do antes del sujeto I.

origin.text: Rarely ___ I see the fans so calm.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué hizo el público al terminar la canción.

choices.text: The audience left before the end.
The audience got up and cheered right away.
The audience asked for another song.

feedback.es: No sooner had Mia finished… than… indica que el aplauso fue inmediato, apenas acabó la canción.

origin.audio: No sooner had Mia finished her song than everybody got up and cheered.
